DOTA_Crownfall_Shmup_HowToPlay_Descripti:
MOVE
Use [WASD] or [Arrow Keys] to move Shen.

SHOOT
Hold [Left Click] or [Z] to shoot. Deal 2x damage to enemies of the opposite color.

SHIELD
Shen's artifact absorbs attacks of the matching color.[Right Click] or [X] to switch colors.

SUPER
Absorbing attacks charges up the artifact. While charged, [Middle Click] or [SPACE] to unleash its power.

SCORE
Kill 3 enemies of the same color in a row to extend your COMBO CHAIN for lots of points.

CONTROLLERS
Move Shen using the directional stick, shoot with [A], swap colors with [B] or [X], and unleash your Special Attack with [Y].
